specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent raster VFX sprite atlas for a smartphone-only dark Japanese post-apocalyptic side-view strategy game. Create ONE sprite sheet, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, six equally sized square cells, overall 3:2 landscape canvas (ideally 1536x1024). Read frames left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row. It is a single coherent 0.54-second one-shot animation, not six different design alternatives. Every cell uses the SAME unmoving physical ground anchor at cell center x and 70.3% cell height. Frame1 is the first physical emission, frame2 the forceful peak, frame3 expanding matter, frame4 falling fragments, frame5 dispersing haze, frame6 a small residual. Strong physical painted detail with cinematic readable silhouettes, irregular matter, excellent smooth visual continuity. Genuine transparent RGBA background throughout; no opaque background, no floor plane, no checkerboard, no grid lines, no text or numbers, no UI. At least 20px fully transparent safety margin inside ALL FOUR edges of EVERY cell, with dust and smoke fading naturally to exact transparency, no effects crossing cell boundaries. These are environmental/attack particles only: absolutely no people, animals, monsters, faces, anatomy, limbs, weapons, buildings or intact armor. No circles, rings, symbols, polygons, flat vector art, diagrams, starburst icons or clean geometric light shapes. The large peak must feel powerful yet remain contained in each cell, leaving open transparent space between particles.
Specific effect: a brood-vault pressure eruption, grounded low at the fixed pivot, with a turbulent upward bloom of reddish-brown fibrous dust, damp mist, muddy droplets and drifting spore-like flecks. A warm pale dense core opens into curled, wet-looking brown plumes and tiny irregular particles; no fireball and no generic explosion. The motion has heavy organic pressure and a short upward burst, followed by distinct settling droplets and thinning mist. Do not depict body damage, blood, organs, eggs, creatures or pieces of the boss. Keep the palette muted rust, dusty umber and faint warm ivory, matching an organic industrial horror battlefield.
